status: adopted for Phase F specification; not complete-plan or runtime acceptance
title: Bounded string ceiling for the canonical value schema
problem: values.schema.json#/$defs/string was an unconstrained {"type": "string"} resolved by 907 references, so every bounded field in the contract registries inherited no bound at all. An unbounded string in a canonically hashed, durably stored record is a storage and denial-of-service surface, and the schema could not refuse a payload no implementation would want to keep.
decision: Set maxLength 8192 characters and forbid C0 and C7 control characters except tab, newline and carriage return. The ceiling is a mechanism decision taken to replace an absent bound, not a value derived from any observed field length; it is revisable through an explicit schema migration under the kernel's evolution rules.
alternatives: Leave the type unconstrained, which is the pre-repair state and constrains 907 references to nothing
Set per-field ceilings at each of the 907 reference sites, which is more precise and 907 places to drift
Set a higher or lower shared ceiling, which is the same decision at a different number
epistemic_basis: Design decision under an absent bound. No field-length distribution was measured and none is claimed: the schema's own description says the exact ceiling is a storage and denial-of-service decision and is flagged for the founder, not derived.
accepted_design_costs: A field that legitimately needs more than 8192 characters must be a blob reference or a schema migration, not a longer string
The ceiling is shared, so it is simultaneously too large for short identifiers and too small for long documents; per-field precision is traded for one place to change
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if an admitted record type genuinely requires a longer inline value, if a measured field-length distribution contradicts the ceiling, or if the founder sets a different storage bound. Changing it is a schema major change and requires the migration protocol of 01 section 11, not a field rename. Origin: canonical repair R6.

status: adopted; mechanism decision derived from the selected architecture; revisable by a reviewed ChangeProposal

title: Performance of a sale is accepted delivery plus discharged or transferred obligations — never payment alone
problem: G2-01 (d): criterion.SalesAgreement.performed.v1 demanded exactly what accepted demanded; SalesAgreement had no relation to Fulfillment; a paid but undelivered sale could reach performed. "What evidence constitutes performance of a sale" was unstated, and the two available inventions (payment settled / delivery accepted) describe different companies.
decision: SalesAgreement gains /payload/fulfillment_ref → Fulfillment; criterion.SalesAgreement.performed.v1 requires Fulfillment in a delivered/accepted state and every linked Obligation discharged or transferred; payment settlement moves the agreement to accepted or partially-performed, not performed. Fulfillment gains a domain lifecycle (proposed → delivering → delivered → failed | refunded) with an authenticated attributable event on the delivered edge.
alternatives: Payment settled = performed (rejected: makes a paid-but-undelivered sale complete; contradicts SalesAgreement.invariants[0] and 02 §6)
Leave to implementation (rejected: the reviewer showed this is the silent path, and both choices are plausible to an implementer)

Split into performed_paid and performed_delivered (rejected: two "performed" states invite the same conflation the protocol names; the existing accepted / partially-performed states already hold the paid-not-delivered case)
evidence_and_reasoning: 02 §3 "accepted work cannot discharge external standing through an internal status"; 02 §6 "Delivery produces independently observed results"; the record's own invariant "performance is shown by substantive fulfillment" was enforced by nothing (G2-01 counterexample validated). Requiring Fulfillment delivered and Obligations discharged/transferred makes the prose true.
epistemic_basis: Decision. Derived from the adopted S1.0 selection (02-architecture-selection.md §3, §6) and from the consistency of the existing closure-edge set in contracts/record-registry.json; not from new evidence and not from a founder value. The Phase G reviewer classified the gap (d): implementation would otherwise settle it silently.
accepted_design_costs: Fulfillment must gain a domain lifecycle (G2-05) before any sale can reach performed; a service with no observable delivery event cannot be marked performed by payment alone and must record why. More edges, more evidence, less convenience — deliberately.
external_exposure_authorized: None. A contract change; no spend, publication, contact or deployment.
reversibility: Reversible before B04 by editing the SalesAgreement/Fulfillment contracts; after live sales, a migration under 02 §10 (T-R1).
reopen_trigger: A lawful offer class whose performance genuinely IS payment (e.g. a donation with no deliverable) that the Fulfillment lifecycle cannot represent without a fictitious delivery; or measured owner labor from performing the distinction exceeding its benefit under CF1 maintenance comparison.
implementation_evidence: None yet. Guard repair lane owed; independent recheck owed; no runtime exists.

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: Consequence class is the routing axis, and the reached set governs — never a rank
problem: The F2 round had to pick a routing unit for the work / agents / authority / skills / context / routing layer, and every candidate carried blocking findings that clustered on its own routing unit. R2 F-20 established that there is no single unit of justification: the founder's five criteria predicate on five different objects, and a criterion applied to the wrong unit returns undecidable, which reads as satisfied. The hybrid candidate routed on consequence class but computed one governing class by max() over a rank, and AT-M4-02 showed an action reaching two classes gated by only the higher row — while 02-authority-recovery.md §4 already requires that an action satisfying several classes meet all their gates.
decision: Consequence class is layer 1 and decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how work runs and what each step may see (layer 2), a typed standing interest decides when work becomes due (layer 3), an existence record decides whether a worker may be created at all (layer 4), and exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives the case carrying it (layer 5). When two layers disagree the lower-numbered layer governs. The derivation returns the SET of reached classes and every reached class's gates apply. No total rank exists, no severity score is computed and no seventh class is added, so no monotonicity proof is owed (R-D22). One implementation of the derivation function exists; changing the function, the mapping table, the holder set or a declared floor is a protected control change.
alternatives: Rank the reached classes and gate on the maximum — the hybrid candidate's construction, which drops gates the fixed boundary already requires (AT-M4-02)

Route on the worker, as the capability-differentiated and chartered candidates do — it makes the routing unit a property of the worker rather than of the work, and inherits that unit's blind spot (R2 F-20)
Route on the declared procedure alone — it decides how work runs and cannot decide who may act on work no procedure covers
Adopt one candidate whole rather than layering the units — every candidate's blockers cluster on its own unit, so adopting one adopts its blind spot
Close the founder's reason list at five, which remains his to do: it makes this design inadmissible on his own gate and is registered as TC-35
evidence_and_reasoning: research/F2/cross-lane-comparison.md (R2 F-20: no single unit of justification)
epistemic_basis: Inference on a founder constraint, plus a restatement of a fixed boundary. The reached-set rule is 02 §4 restated rather than changed. The choice of routing axis is an inference from R2 F-20 and from the observed clustering of each candidate's blockers on its own unit; no runtime measured it. The layer precedence ORDER is the selection record's own marked design proposal with no finding behind it (§13, row 70), and it is the load-bearing unevidenced choice here: nothing in this round tests a precedence between routing units, because no candidate had more than one.
accepted_design_costs: Every action carries a set rather than one class, so gate evaluation is a conjunction over rows and cannot be short-circuited by a comparison
The precedence between layers is unevidenced; if it is wrong, the whole selection is wrong and nothing in this round would have caught it
The added structure is not paid for if more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes, which is this layer's own removal criterion
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen when more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes over a fixed window, or when the derivation and the declared floor agree on every action over a window — then the derivation adds nothing the floor already said and the floor alone survives. Reopen layer 1's release path if the runtime holds no credential at the boundary that can be narrowed: attenuation is then unavailable, the constraint must be enforced by mediation, and that is a different architecture (§11.1.2). Also reopen if the admission authority's concentration measurably misses important work, raises founder labour or obstructs independently capable domains. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §1, §11.3.

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: The class is computed from records the acting party cannot author, and recomputed at the effect
problem: A consequence class computed from anything the acting party can author is a boundary that party can move. R4 found tool self-description, command-text matching, instruction scoping, definition-file authority and sandbox verdicts each insufficient as the input to an authority decision (R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12; AG-08). Separately, a class computed at admission and never re-checked is a grant checked against bytes that are not the bytes released (AS-M4-02).
decision: The class derives by one deterministic function from resolved parameters, the destination and egress identity, the selector closure over conflict claims, deletion scopes and open obligations, and the owning capability contract's declared floor — every one a record the acting party cannot author. The class is recomputed inside the ordered release transaction on the frozen bytes; a mismatch PARKS and never resolves downward. ConsequenceDerivation is append-only and written only inside the release path, and its mismatch disposition is writable only by the party owning the park. An executor's grant scope is a proposal right; C04 performs every release. Where a dimension is unresolvable the class resolves to the ceiling of the unresolved dimensions.
alternatives: Compute the class once at admission and trust it at release — the grant is then checked against bytes that are not the bytes released (AS-M4-02)
Let the acting worker or a model declare its own class, refused because a boundary a party can author is a boundary that party can move (R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12)
Resolve a release-time mismatch downward to the lower class, refused: it parks, and a park is a state with an owner rather than a silent continue
Screen a false entry rather than gate on it, refused: a poisoning attack carrying no instruction at all passed a four-stage screen 360 times out of 360 (R1 F-10)
evidence_and_reasoning: planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 3-5: R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12, AG-08, AS-M4-02)
epistemic_basis: Source claim plus specification. The refused inputs are R4's measurements, made elsewhere and not by this project; the recompute-at-release rule takes AS-M4-02 as the gap and is this record's specification as the repair. The one-implementation rule is a direct observation on this repository's own classifier, where two implementations of one risk classification disagreed and it was found during an incident.
accepted_design_costs: A release transaction carries a second derivation and the cost of freezing the bytes before it
A parked mismatch needs a party who owns the park — a staffing precondition, not a code path

Resolving an unresolvable dimension to its ceiling is deliberately conservative and will refuse some legitimate work; false exclusion is unmeasured everywhere in the corpus (U-12) and this decision adds to it
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if the runtime holds no credential at the boundary that can be narrowed, because layer 1's release path is then mediation rather than attenuation (§11.1.2). Reopen on a demonstrated class input that only the acting party can supply and for which no non-authorable substitute exists, or if recomputation parks so often that the release path is unusable. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §5.1 R-L1.

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: A step declares its read set, and the loader delivers and records it
problem: "The checker did not read the producer's rationale" was an assertion in every candidate and a fact in none: the caller claimed its read list and nothing recorded what was actually delivered. R7 §7 and F9 establish that independence of INFLUENCE is the half of verification that is reachable at all, and it is reachable only if delivery is observed rather than claimed. R2 F-03 and R3 F51-F52 add the discriminator: auto-generated multi-agent systems underperformed a single agent at up to ten times the cost while an expert-designed one reached 96.5% against 57.0% on the same diagnostic, and what separates them is whether separation is enforced by construction or only described in prompts.
decision: WorkflowDefinition and StepExecution gain step_kind ∈ {compute, model, human, professional, effect}, declared_read_set, declared_grants, validator_ref, branch_set and critical_fields — as fields on existing registry records, never as new records. The loader delivers the declared read set and RECORDS what it actually delivered; the caller's claimed read list is not trusted. A guard is a pure function over typed outputs and journal state, and a model's output is an input to a guard and never a jump. The step boundary is the checkpoint and the cost is carried. One effect per effect step, and the step is the idempotency unit. Procedure admission refuses a branch set in which a model-authored value selects between acceptance strengths.
alternatives: Trust the caller's declared read list — the pre-repair state, an assertion no record can contradict
Blind the checker by instruction in a prompt, refused: separation enforced by construction is the measured discriminator (R2 F-03, R3 F51, F52)
A separate reserved closing-allowance predicate instead of checkpointing every step boundary, which needs a denominator this round establishes does not exist
Let a model step select a branch, refused: a model's output is an input to a guard, and acceptance-strength selection is a guard over journal state and consequence class
evidence_and_reasoning: planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 7-12: AT §E.2, R7 §7 and F9, R2 F-09, F-18, R3 F29, F30, F41, F44)
epistemic_basis: Source claim plus inference. The loader-records-delivery rule rests on R7's influence-independence findings and on AT §E.2; the step-boundary checkpoint is AT-M1-03's own second branch taken whole. The five step kinds as an EXHAUSTIVE set is a marked design proposal with no finding behind it (§13, row 9), and its falsifier is one real work item that fits none of them.
accepted_design_costs: Checkpointing every step boundary carries a real per-step cost, and taking the step model takes its dominant unpriced cost with it: the per-step cacheless launch cost against a long-session arm is unmeasured (U-11), and the expected-launch count per procedure version is the instrument that would price it
Authoring and maintaining declared procedures is layer 2's real cost and is unevaluable in any unit today (U-7)

The loader's record proves what was delivered, not that the delivery was the right set; the provider may edit context after any loader has recorded its inputs, and what one compaction event loses in load-bearing facts is unmeasured (U-4)
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen when a newer model passes every step's declared validator with the step merged into its neighbour or removed — a scaffold's contribution is a function of the generation that motivated it and must be re-ablated when the model changes (§11.3, L2). Reopen the layer's foundation if a defence rests on a mechanism nobody can test. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §5.1 R-L2, §11.3.

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: Acceptance criteria are authored by the capability owner, frozen before the producing step, and unamendable by the producing path
problem: AS-X-01 found a fourth unblinded channel into the checker that no research lane named: the acceptance criteria themselves, authored by the producing path. AX had tested the three channels R7 named — the producer's rationale, the producer's preferred conclusion and the shared record — and found them closed in all five candidates, recording no blocking finding on W5. The consolidation recorded the two dispositions as in conflict with no review owning the reconciliation.
decision: The capability owner authors the acceptance criteria at procedure admission. They are versioned and frozen BEFORE the producing step starts; the producing path may neither author nor amend them, and an amendment between admission and submission is refused by a guard. Fixture F-4 gains a fourth arm in which the criteria are authored by the producing path, reported beside the existing three. W5 is recorded as sufficient on the three tested channels and UNESTABLISHED on the fourth until that arm runs; AX's judgement is not overturned. A check reads only fields the producer could not author, its tie-break inverts to strongest-sufficient, and a checker with no paired clean-case refusal rate resolves unresolved, never pass.
alternatives: Treat AS-X-01 as non-blocking because the lane that raised it did not own the dimension, refused: a finding's class under protocol §5 is a property of the finding — its trigger, its resulting failure, its affected requirement — and not of which lane noticed it
Pin the criteria inside an immutable procedure only, which is the workflow-first candidate's exemption and does not cover the adaptive and unclassified paths this synthesis also admits
Record W5 as sufficient on the verdict matrix alone, which reports an assurance whose scope is unstated
Author plausible criteria inside the producing path and rely on review to catch a bad one, which is the silent path an implementer would otherwise take

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: Relevance is computed by deterministic arming, and no component may prevent an interest arming
problem: A shared source of truth nobody is forced to read is not a source of truth, and a deferral nobody can see is indistinguishable from an oversight. The subscription-activated candidate is the only one in the round where an item's relevance is computed rather than remembered, and nothing in it stopped a component from suppressing an arming. Its own two blocking findings followed from letting an activation promote what it investigated.
decision: StandingInterest and the ArmedSet are registered. Preconditions are deterministic, NO MODEL may appear in a precondition, and all prerequisites gate. Five admission verbs and five prohibitions. The armed set is a computed projection with no lifecycle and no writer: no component may prevent membership, and the admission authority holds no write access to precondition-bearing kinds. A trial interest is admissible only at the two lowest effect classes, may not declare a writer key, and may write only a proposed revision of a constraint. The unmatched pool is the computable complement, with retention exceeding the longest plausible outage and an alarm with a named reader — and its residue is named rather than covered: it cannot catch an entry that armed the WRONG interest. The admission authority gains a per-origin arming rate as a refusal predicate.
alternatives: Rely on scheduled review alone, which is precisely this layer's removal criterion and the thing to test rather than assume
Let a model evaluate a precondition, refused: a false entry could then change what becomes due, and an untrusted entry may activate only read-only work
Allow a component to suppress an arming for throughput, refused: it makes a deferral invisible and returns the absence-versus-oversight ambiguity the layer exists to remove
Let a trial interest declare a writer key, refused by a deterministic admission check that names the failed predicate (R-D16)

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: A worker exists only against a justification naming one reason, its unit and a test that can return false
problem: Negative control 4 asks which frozen fixture exercises a persistent or standing structure, and specialized knowledge was the most-used reason for creating a worker in the round. Across 4 model families, 162 roles and 2,410 questions, adding a persona gave no benefit and picking the best persona was no better than random (R2 F-10, R6 F6, TC-33). A reason with no unit and no falsifiable test is rhetoric, and control 4 was never applied to two of the five candidates at all.
decision: ExistenceJustification is one record per AgentInstance, written by C02 at admission and expiring with the instance. It names exactly one of six reasons, each with its unit: permission scope → a permission scope; input provenance → an input set; consequence class → an effect class; confidentiality boundary → a context boundary; named partition → a partition; verification relation → a relation between two attempts. The proposed → admitted transition is REFUSED if the decidable test cannot return false. Specialized knowledge is refused as a reason and predicates on a skill version instead; provider or account separation folds into ExecutionSelection. Attributable identity is mandatory for every worker and is never a reason to create one. There is no persistent roster, and the profile-convergence probe is the control against one appearing.
alternatives: Keep specialized knowledge as a reason to create a worker, overturned on measurement rather than on preference (R2 F-10, R6 F6, TC-33)
Charter a persistent roster, which is the chartered candidate — it failed negative control 4 on the one chartered desk no fixture exercises
Grant existence on a permission check alone, which is this layer's own removal criterion and becomes right the moment no admitted worker names another reason
Admit a reason with no unit, refused: the admission test must be able to return false or the record is rhetoric with a schema

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: Standing accountability is a record with an address and a reservation; carried model memory is refused
problem: A duty that outlives the case carrying it needs a party who is still there once the case is closed: a grievance six months after closure with the custodian implicated, a deletion scope whose clock runs after the case ends, a day-five incident at the terminus of an escalation ladder. Universal ownership and no ownership are one state (R5-11). The chartered candidate answered this with persistent agents carrying model memory and failed negative control 4 on the one desk no fixture exercises; the capability-differentiated candidate carried the same hole silently.
decision: StandingHolder is a record keyed by holder_id, proposed → staffed → suspended → retired_into(holder_id), proposed by the capability owner and endorsed by C01. Exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives its case, admitted by a three-part conjunction. The prohibition set is structural: a holder never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries NO model memory. "A holder prepares" means an ephemeral worker instantiated under the holder's mandate carrying the holder's reservation ref and intake address and nothing else of the holder's. staffed → retired_into is refused while any duty it holds is live, and suspension stops admission in that duty class rather than leaving work assigned and silent. Every acceptance-owner role is a record with a reachability route, a capacity reservation, an alternate and a review date; every published intake carries per-counterparty and per-origin sub-caps whose exhaustion behaviour PRESERVES intake. A proposed holder exercised by no frozen fixture is refused on sight.
alternatives: Persistent agents carrying model memory, refused: reachability is separable from carried memory, and carried model identity has no supporting evidence and two deployments refusing to support it (R8 A-7)
No standing layer at all, which leaves a surviving duty with no address — the state R5-11 names
Charter every proposed holder, refused: a holder exercised by no frozen fixture is unjustified, which is the mechanical form of negative control 4
Give the holder a veto over work in its duty class, refused: a holder that can veto can hold an empty bucket hostage (see AD-022)

status: adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance
title: A reservation's minimum is evidence, not consent, and unconsumed allowance lapses independently of its holder
problem: Two candidates ask the protected-lane holder before shedding and two apply a pre-endorsed order; the consolidation records opposite and individually correct positions with neither refuted, and two live blocking findings fail in OPPOSITE directions from that one question — nothing can halt a shed, and nothing can override a refusal. Separately, the session window resets on schedule whether consumed or not (R8 §3), so a reserve under a non-rolling allowance is waste rather than thrift, and no published denominator exists for expressing a reserve as an absolute quantity.
decision: A protected-lane holder's stated minimum is EVIDENCE, never consent: there is no veto, and a returned minimum is recorded as evidence and does not block. Unconsumed reservation releases to the pool at a time-triggered lapse point independent of any holder's consent, with a declared cross-class release precedence and a lapsed-unconsumed record. Reservation gains holder_ref, stated_minimum and lapse_point; ShedDecision records the lane, the authority, the obligations that moved with named custodians, the stated minimum, whether it was breached, the overflow count and the lapsed-unconsumed quantity. Shares are fractions of the OBSERVED allowance, never absolute quantities. The exhaustion rule is distinct from the pressure rule: when the allowance is empty and a due obligation falls due, the named non-model production mode performs it, a named recipient is alerted, and the breach-or-perform decision leaves a record naming which was chosen and why.
alternatives: Ask the holder and honour a refusal, which lets a holder hold an empty bucket hostage and is one of the two unrefuted positions
Execute a pre-endorsed order with no prohibition on refusal, which cannot notice that this particular shed is catastrophic — conceded in the workflow-first candidate's own words
Express reserves as absolute quantities, refused: no published denominator exists and every figure this round can produce is a ratio between arms
Let unconsumed reservation persist past the reset, refused: it is destroyed by the provider on schedule, so holding it is waste priced as thrift
evidence_and_reasoning: planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 24-26, 59: R8 §3, §8, W-6, MG-03, TC-26, AE-M4-01, AT and AE §E.2)
epistemic_basis: Source claim and decision under a PRESERVED disagreement. The lapse rule rests on R8 §3; the no-veto rule on AE-M4-01 and R8 §8. The combination — a pre-endorsed order AND the no-veto prohibition — is the one neither pair of candidates proposed, and it is a choice under uncertainty rather than a resolution: whether a shed at the pressure threshold has time for a negotiation round has never been measured. The cross-class lapse PRECEDENCE ORDER is the selection record's own marked design proposal (§13, row 25). The lane shares, the stated minimums and the lapse point are a founder decision and no default is invented here.
accepted_design_costs: A holder can be shed against its stated minimum, and the breach is what the founder is alerted to — the design accepts that it cannot notice that one particular shed is catastrophic
Generous reserves are destroyed unconsumed at the reset; tight reserves breach minimums under pressure. There is no setting that avoids both
The discriminating measurement is unrun, and the nearest instrument — one shed decision run twice on a tabletop — costs nothing and runs at the current pin
reversibility: Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.
reopen_trigger: Reopen on changed provider terms or semantics: the launch window, the concurrency pin, the cache lifetime, the metered affordance and the context-editing surface are provider properties, and a change to any of them moves this cost model (§11.1.4). Reopen the shed-authority half when the founder answers the halt-or-reverse packet, or when the shed tabletop is run and counts founder reversals against breached minimums. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §9 dissent F-1, §5.1 R-X24.
